dbt_project.yml:
name: komtas_rm2
version: '1.0'
config-version: 2
profile: komtas_rm2
model-paths: [models]
test-paths: [tests]
models:
  komtas_rm2:
    staging:
      +materialized: view
    marts:
      +materialized: table
profiles.yml:
komtas_rm2:
  target: demo
  outputs:
    demo:
      type: postgres
      host: "{{ env_var('PGHOST') }}"
      port: 5432
      user: "{{ env_var('PGUSER') }}"
      password: "{{ env_var('PGPASSWORD') }}"
      dbname: komtas_rm2
      schema: dwh
      threads: 2
      connect_timeout: 15
models/sources.yml:
version: 2
sources:
  - name: raw
    schema: raw
    tables:
      - name: sales_line
      - name: dim_date
      - name: dim_product
      - name: dim_outlet
      - name: dim_promotion
models/marts/fact_sales.sql:
select s.sales_line_key,s.sale_date as date_key,s.outlet_key,s.product_key,s.promotion_key,
 s.sold_units,s.returned_units,
 s.sold_units*s.unit_price_eur as gross_revenue_eur,
 s.sold_units*s.unit_price_eur*s.discount_rate as discount_amount_eur,
 s.returned_units*s.unit_price_eur*(1-s.discount_rate) as return_amount_eur,
 (s.sold_units-s.returned_units)*p.liters_per_unit as net_volume_liters,
 s.source_reference
from {{ ref('stg_sales') }} s join {{ ref('dim_product') }} p using(product_key)
models/marts/v_sales_detail.sql:
{{ config(materialized='view') }}
select f.*,d.month_start,o.country,o.channel,o.distributor_key,o.distributor_name,o.outlet_name,
 p.product_name,p.category,r.promotion_name
from {{ ref('fact_sales') }} f join {{ ref('dim_date') }} d using(date_key)
join {{ ref('dim_outlet') }} o using(outlet_key)
join {{ ref('dim_product') }} p using(product_key)
join {{ ref('dim_promotion') }} r using(promotion_key)
models/schema.yml:
version: 2
models:
  - name: stg_sales
    description: Sentetik kaynak satis satirlari; gecersiz anahtarlar burada yakalanir.
    columns:
      - name: sales_line_key
        tests: [not_null, unique]
      - name: product_key
        tests:
          - not_null
          - relationships:
              to: ref('dim_product')
              field: product_key
  - name: fact_sales
    description: Brut, iskonto, iade ve net litre bilesenleri. Merkezi metric API degildir.
    columns:
      - name: sales_line_key
        tests: [not_null, unique]
      - name: outlet_key
        tests:
          - relationships:
              to: ref('dim_outlet')
              field: outlet_key
  - name: dim_product
    description: Urun ve ambalaj litre tanimi.
    columns:
      - name: product_key
        tests: [not_null, unique]
  - name: dim_outlet
    description: Ulke, kanal ve distributor kirilimi.
    columns:
      - name: outlet_key
        tests: [not_null, unique]
  - name: dim_date
    description: Ocak Subat 2025 takvimi.
  - name: dim_promotion
    description: Sentetik promosyon etiketleri; nedensellik kaniti degildir.
  - name: v_sales_detail
    description: BI ve is sorgularina sunulan satis gorunumu.
tests/reference_revenue.sql: select 1 as failure where (select sum(gross_revenue_eur-discount_amount_eur-return_amount_eur) from {{ ref('v_sales_detail') }} where month_start=date '2025-02-01' and channel='HoReCa') is distinct from 3628.80::numeric
